BootPreset.description: How a camera starts with FujiMod.

oneOf.description: The firmware installed in internal flash.

FujiMod loaded from the SD card by the boot ROM; the card is
`sd_card`, or the current release card when it names no contents.

FujiMod started from the SD card's autostart installer in internal
flash.

CardFile.description: One file on a card: a host file, or its bytes in base64.

CardLayout.description: A declared FAT geometry for a freshly formatted card.

partition_start.description: First sector of the FAT partition.

sectors_per_cluster.description: Sectors per FAT cluster: a power of two from 1 to 128.

oneOf.description: Deterministic: runs compare instruction for instruction.
Faster where the result cannot differ.

FirmwareFiles.description: The firmware's two files as host paths.

boot_rom.description: The boot ROM capture, for a firmware whose start runs it.

LoaderImage.description: A RAM image the native loader starts from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the image, which the open checks.

RunFaceResultProfile.description: Closed selection of external face detector results.

StorageCard.description: A card in one of the body's storage slots.

directory.description: Host path of a folder whose tree becomes the card's files.

files.description: Files on a freshly formatted card, by their full path on the card.

image.description: Host path of a raw card image, read without being written.

initialization_fault.description:
The modeled SD host's initialization fault, as the device model names
it.

layout.description: FAT geometry for a freshly formatted card, in place of the run's.

present.description: Whether the card is in the slot at power-on. Omitted, true.

transfer_ticks.description: Guest ticks the modeled host charges for each data transfer.

write_protected.description: Whether the card's write-protect switch is set. Omitted, false.

application_plan.description:
Host path of the application startup plan an X-Processor 4 or
X-Processor Pro firmware starts from.

boot.description: How the camera starts with FujiMod. Omitted, `stock`.

boot_cache.description:
Restore a saved boot with the same inputs, and save this one. Omitted,
true.

cfexpress_card.description: The card in the CFexpress Type B slot, on a body that has one.

date.description: The camera clock at power-on, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` local time.

engine.description: Scheduler engine: `unicorn` or `hypervisor`. Omitted, the run's engine.

face_result_profile.description:
External face detector results in place of the passive face bank:
`empty`, `box64x20` or `box172x120`.

firmware.description:
The body's firmware: a version such as `7.30`, a firmware identity
such as `xh2s-730`, or `none` for an empty flash. Omitted, the newest
firmware the catalog has for the body.

firmware_files.description:
The firmware's update and boot ROM as host files, in place of the
firmware library's.

flash_image.description: Host path of a saved image of the internal flash's stage-1 blocks.

hold.description:
Hold a power-on combination from the body's controls, such as `sd`,
`firmware_update` or `service`, from power-on. A `stock` boot only.

loader_image.description:
Start at the native loader with a RAM image at address zero, in place
of the boot ROM. A `stock` boot only.

nand_image.description:
Host path of a saved committed internal-flash image, restored before
the first instruction.

overlays.description: Catalog overlays of the firmware's run configuration.

run_to_rec.description:
Run to REC before returning. Omitted, true; false returns before the
first instruction with the power-on holds applied.

scene.description:
Host path of a scene document the sensor sees, in place of the run's
declared scene.

sd_card.description: The card in the first SD slot. Omitted, one empty SD card is inserted.

sd_card_2.description: The card in the second SD slot, on a body that has one.

settings.description:
Named camera settings the firmware's settings record writes before the
first instruction, such as `{"language": "en", "setup": "done"}`.

snapshot.description: Host path of a checkpoint file to restore instead of booting.
